entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tikotamise tose musoro yedu. Hanzi, “Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Rangu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] ipapo ndiripowo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanokuyeuchidzai kuti, “Gugudza unodii…? [Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,’] tsvaka unoita sei…? [Congregation says, ‘unowana,’] kumbira unodii…?” [Congregation says, “unopihwa.”] Hanzi, “Regai munhu wese, ave murevi weyi…? [Congregation says, ‘wenhema,’] wenhema, Mwari vareve chii…?” [Congregation says, “chokwadi/zvokwadi.”] Kune vanotenda Mwari vakati, “All things are possible.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kune vanotenda, “All things are…?” [Congregation says, “are possible.”] Handi’moona kutaura kweShoko raMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Hanzi, “Kumbirai neZita Rangu, kuti mufaro wenyu uza…?” [Congregation says, “uzadziswe.”] Usanzi, “Wakaita chivi ndakusiya.” Mwari akati, “Ndinewe kusvika kumagumo enyika.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ende ndakakuponesa unconditionally.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iva nokutenda kwakazara pane chishuvo chaunacho manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanokuitira pakuguma kweshuma… (Inaudible 0:00:56) [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Baba wedu tinotenda manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda kunaka Kwenyu mukati memba ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda kuunganidzwa kwataitwa Nemi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makati, “Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Renyu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Imi muripowo ipapo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makati, “Vaviri venyu vakabvumirana pachinhu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Imi munochiita kudenga.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tabvumirana kudzinga Satan pano, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muZita raJeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Makativimbisa kuti, “…We possess the gates of the enemy.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makativimbisa kuti pataisa tsoka ndepedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satan come out of everybody! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ungava mumweya wehurombo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mumweya wohurwerwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mumweya webopoto pakati pevanhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toutsuura muZita raJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Come out of everybody Satan! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Batsirai Tenzi wakarurama muyenzi umwe neumwe ari pakati pedu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] abve pano ajekerwa neShoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka vese vangadei vaine pfungwa mbiri pane chokunamata, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vajekeserei Shoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba kune vatadza kuva pano tinovaisa muMaoko Enyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tichiisa umwe neumwe wedu kunyangwe hama dzedu dzisipo pano, ngativei vamwe chete pakunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kuuya kwataita chitaurai nemweya yedu Baba. Tigobuda muno tichiti, “Zvanga zvakanaka kuti tive mumba Menyu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taurai nesu, “Mudzoze maziso edu ne eye salve. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzingisai zvipfuva zvedu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiropafadzei Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nevatsvene Baba vari mu diaspora vese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nevatsvene vari Botsvana. Ivai nevatsvene vari Joni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nevatsvene kumaguta ose, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] avo tinonamata navo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tinotenda nekuunganidzwa kwataita muno Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taurai pakati pedu Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigobuda muno tichifara, kutenda kwedu kwakazembera paShoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokudza Imi manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Namatwai nekusingapere Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pindirai pamharidzo yezuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] MuZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Aiwa tinotenda Mwari. Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichikwazisa vayenzi vese vari pakati pedu. Nhasi ndine hanzvadzi yangu, uhm…Mai Muyambo. Takakura tose. Ndovatai va…vaive mudiki kwandiri havo ne two years, handiti? One year? [Mai Muyambo says, “Haa, akawanda.”] Akawanda? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Handichaziva kuti mangani. Ndovandakakura navo avo, nevamwe vanonzi Sisi… Nyembesi naSisi Morina. Ava vainzi Sisi Naomi ava. Saka ndinofara kuti nhasi vandi… (Inaudible 0:03:19) ndichiparidza Vhangeri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wangu chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo, handi’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Then nhasi tina…tina mukwasha Chatima, nemwanasikana wangu Grace. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tine mufaro kuva navo muKereke yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vaita zvakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Then tina Sister Brenda, vauya nema lab tech. Vari kuita ma lab tech nevamwe vavo ve…? [Congregation says, “vese,”] vese. Tinovagamuchira muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu kuva muimba yaani…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari,”] yaMwari.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Zvagara hazvo muimba yaMwari hamuna muye…? [Congregation says, “muyenzi.”] Hamuna muyenzi, ha’moona. Rinenge rangovawo zuva rako rokutanga kupinda nesu, saka tinozviremekedza chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo, ha’moona. Saka toda kuenda mberi nokuparidzirana iVhangeri. Shoko raMwari rinoti iro, “You can never pray too…? [Congregation says, ‘too much,’] too much.” Handi’moona. Hapana. Ukanamata twenty-four seven, it’s never too much and it’s never enou…? [Congregation says, “enough,”] enough. Nekuti toda kugara tiri pamberi paMwari zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndaitoti kana Mwari vakandiitira nyasha, ndiri kuda kutoti kana dai zvaibvira, tikwanise kuita ma early morning se…? [Congregation says, “service,”] services. Tikwanise kuita ma early morning services. Tokwanisa kuita lunch hour services. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tokwanisa kuita futi manheru. Ko handi’ndomadyiro awunoita panyama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, ngaingovawo same staira payi…? [Congregation says, “pamweya.”] Ehe. Breakfast, lunch and what…? [Congregation says, “supper,”] supper.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka when the work becomes much less than what it is now…Iye zvino tiri kugadzira pokuti tinyatsokwanisa kupindira takatambanuka. When things are normal, ndendichitoda ma services anoitwa kuseni. Before everyone aenda kubasa, vanenge vachikwanisa vaya, na six touya topinda chii… church. Ha’moona? Seven-thirty tapedza vanhu va’akumhanya kuenda kumai…? Kumabasa. Muchiuya pa lunch hour, exactly one o’clock ndaakuparidza. Handi’mukuona ehe. Quarter to two, [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] tapedza, todzokera kumabasa, handiti. Touya [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] manheru. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: “…Pray without ceasing.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona. Ndochinangwa chandakagara ndinacho every day muhupenyu. I’ve never been able to do that. Now Mwari nenyasha Dzake manje muri kuona kuti kuno kuHarare zvinenge zvichakwanisika kaizvi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Saka ndozvatakagara tichida kuti ndoita morning, afternoon, evening. Ende ini handina hunyope hwokuparidza. Aah ipapo handina, hunyope handina.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Panguva yandakanga ndisingaparidze hakusi kuti ndakanga ndiine hunyope kana ndaka’andisina chekuparidza. Munoziva munhu unogomera kusvika papoindi yekuti unenge uchiti, kana kufa zvako kuri nani? [Congregation says, “mm-hm.”] Kuti, “Handichada kana kuparidza kwacho! Handichada!” Ndomweya wandaive nawo kudhara kwaya after October 2000. Ndomweya wandaive nawo. Ndosaka ndaigona kuita kana, three weeks ndisingatore ma service ndiri kumba zvangu. Kuti...

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndaitoti pamberi paMwari, “Ko, ichiri kuitei Chechi yacho? Why is the Church there? Dai yanga yadii…? Dai yanga yaparara. Vari kundipa conscience vanhu ava, kana vakaramba vachiungana kwavari uko…” [Apostle Gumbura laughs--ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndopfungwa yandakanga ndinayo. Kuti, “Dai wo—kwangoshaikwa kana munhu one, tongoita natural death zvobva zvangopera.” Because muna 2000 I was very discouraged. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I had put my all mukumhanya kwandaiita kuya kuya uku, pana… just before 2000. I put my all. Kuparidza Early Church Structure, kuparidza Marriage and Divorce, and the Church was going on nicely.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Then just like that, [Apostle makes a sound to illustrate something being destroyed] Ndakagara pasi apa, kupererwa nesimba. Zvinodarikira—zvinodarika eh…kufirwa, nekuti kufirwa unenge uchiti inzira yedu te…? [Congregation says, “tese.”] Ndikati, “What? He? Ko Mwari…?” I was angry at God. I was angry at people that I have trusted. I did not trust even my wives. I did—I did not trust anybody. Ndosaka mukaona nanhasi, zvondinetsa kuita shamwari.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndonetseka kuti ndiite shamwari zviri serious. Kuti ndiite munhu wandinoti uyu, ndingaise faith yangu mandiri. Handizati ndamuwana kusvika nanhasi. Wandinoti uyu I—I really trust. Ndakabruis-iwa [I was bruised—ED] zvakaoma panguva iyo iya. Zvokuti munhu wese nde’ndakamutarisa kudai ndichiti, “Ah, VaMakaza ava? [Congregation laughs—ED] Aah, hameno,” handiti. Paya patinenge tichiimba, [Apostle Gumbura sings this next line—ED] Tinotenda zvedu…

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndendakatarisa VaRusono kuti, “Zvino haachafunga kuti ndo’omweya manhingi nenziyo yake iyoyi?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Handi’moona zvande’ndichifunga? Munhu wese ari under suspicion with Pastor Gumbura. Everybody is under suspicion, handitika ehe. Ukaona vana Brother Gwendere vaane matumbu nemotokari dzakanaka woti, “Ah vafanha ava, he? Havachaita arrogant nemari ava, nekufunda vafanha ava? Zvakaita vamwe vaani…? [Congregation says, ‘vavo.’] He? I think this young, man I hope he doesn’t get arrogant.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka munhu wese, I question, huh. Satiya akavaka imba yangu ikabuda zvakanaka ndoti, “But I hope mupfanha uyu ka uyu…” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Handi’moona kuti munhu wese ari under fire? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. The good thing about me I just don’t say it, handitika ehe. But that’s what goes on in my head almost every…? [Congregation says, “every time,”] every time, handiti, ehe.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kuti, “Haa, mupfana uyu, he? Haa mupfan—” Unenge uchingoti ukaona munhu—Iye zvino ndaita kune hama… Murikuona ma drawings aya? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ha’moona. Just before these drawings came, brother ava vakarotewa, Brother… [Apostle Gumbura snaps his fingers once trying to remember the brother’s name] vahedhuka vachikanganisika kunamata. Brother Keith. But Brother Keith ka, kutanga ku drawer chaiko ndini ndaitomuencourage-a, achidraw-a patumakadhibhodi kudai.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndichiti, “No, chengeta mhuri yenyu.” He was the first born, baba hapana. Ndikati, “No, tengesa mbijana mbijana,” turi tuma…tuduku duku. Now he is drawing, zvokuti munhu wese akauya, handitika, anenge achingoti…Nhasi ndandine vamwe ma friends angu auya muno umu, two. Zvikanzi, chinhu chokutanga vachipinda munomu. Zvikanzi, “VaGumbura ndaka…” Ndiye abvunza oga. “Ndakasiya muchigadzira horo iyo, muchiti moda kuiita chechi. Ndoda kunoona kuti yapera here.” Nemuchinda wangu woku Eurotec uya uya anonzi Nyamadzawo. Ndikati, “Haa, shamwari ukapinda uko unorohwa nehana. Kwanaka manje.” Zvikanzi, “Haa, dambonoona. Ndoziva kuti imimi you are always a busy man. Pandafonerwa ndanzwa kuti manga muri kure uko, ha’moona.” Achingopinda muno abva ati, zvikanzi, “Ndiani akadraw-a?” Zvikanzi, “No hakuzi kudraw-a uku. Hm? i -drawing here?” Ndikati, “i -drawing.” Zvikanzi, “Haa. Haa! Ndoda kumuona mupfanha uyu, handiti.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Ha’moona, ehe. Ndikati, “Mupfanha uyu achapedzesera a—a—azvikudza nenyaya iyi, handiti?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Handi’moona zvaunenge uchiita ehe? Baba vangu vaona drawing vadzoka zvikanzi, “Ndandichikumbira kuti andidraw-ewo.” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Handi’moona. Ndobva kwauya mukomana watotengesa naye, anotengesa he—hembe ya—mupfanha, mu—muchi—brother vatinoi—ha—muchinda wechipostori anobva ku China wuya. Zvikanzi, “Haa, iwe, muri kuti i-drawing iyo Pastor?” Abva auya ndokubata so zvikanzi, “I-drawing iyi?” Ndikati, “I-drawing.” Zvikanzi, “Haa.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka munhu wese akangopinda, anobva aona drawing. Ukashaiwa nyasha dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”] You go straight munyika straight. Because vemunyika vanenge vachitaura handiti? Iyewo womunyika a—a—a—akugara achisangana navo, huh. Hanzi one of the whites men vari mu gallery. Handitika? Hanzi, “Aaah, Keith draws like a demon.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Moziva vanhu vemunyika handiti. Vanhu vemunyika hanzi, “Keith draws like a demon.” Handiti. [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Vanhu vemunyika, kwaari anenge achitokupa compliment akadaro. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Kuti madraw-ero acho haazi natu…? [Congregation says, “haazi natural,”] haazi natural, ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ende zveshuwa unenge uchiona kuti munhu ari ku—saka unenge uchiziva zvinhu zvese izvi ka izvi… I’ve seen people that I’ve raised from nothing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] After vaitwa something naMwari, they end up being too argume…? [Congregation says, “argumentative,”] argumentative, ehe. Vanenge vaa too argumentative zvekuti unenge wa’akushaya kuti manje ndomudzora sei mupfanha uyu? Mari yavapo, ava netarenda rake ka…? [Congregation says, “kare,”] kare. Hauna chauchagona kumuita. He can be anything, ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: But, chinhu one chandoda kuti mugare makarangarira mukati moupenyu hwavo. Haikona kufa wakafunga kuti Mwari akakusimudza, haagone kukukoromora kubva ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Izvozvo gara uchizviziva hupenyu hwako hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese.”] Even inini Pastor venyu nhasi uno. Ndikada kungoregera kunamata, munondinzwira tsitsi me…? Mese.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndikangoda kuregera kunamata chete ndikatanga kuda kuita zvinhu zvemusoro wangu, you will all feel sorry for me. Zvinopera zvo…? That supernatural touch inodii iyo iya…? Inopera, inodepart-a supernatural touch iya. Inobva zvacho…? Zvachose, that supernatural touch. Unosara wangova iwe wega, zvekuti vanhu vanenge vachiona kuti apa raa-aa…churu chakapinda nyo…? [Congregation says, “nyoka.”] Kuti, “Pakapinda zinyoka zihombe apa, but zinyoka rakatama ka…? Kare.” Ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu vanhu vaMwari handiti, the more God blesses you, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ita sei kana Mwari achikuropafadza? [Congregation says, “be humble.”] The humbler you become. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The way up, what does Brother Branham teach? Hanzi, “The way what…?” [Congregation mumbles inaudible responses—ED] “The way up is the way…?” [Congregation says, “down.”] Mm. Iva munhu uya anenge ari munyoro. Mwari ngavakuropafadze uchiramba uchizvininipisa.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Wawana mota yakanaka, break down. Wawana imba yakanaka, break down. Wawana murume ane mari, break down. Don’t be arrogant, handi’moona ehe. Wawana basa rakanaka rine authority, ita humble handitika. Wapuhwa property naMwari, ita humble. Haikona kuita show off nezvinhu zvaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinhu zvaMwari hazvidi show off zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose,”] zvachose, handi’moona ehe. Hazvidi show off zvachose.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Now that is the downfall of my partners. [Congregation says, “mm-hm.”] Ma brothers andakatanga kushanda nawo ose, they were humble people when I started with them. But apo Mwari a’akutisimudzira manje, mapoka edu a’akudi…? A’akukura. Vana Brother Marisa va’akuuya mberi kwepurupiti kudaiwo, vakatanga kuzviona sekuti they don’t need their Pastor any…? [Congregation says, “anymore,”] anymore.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: That’s what they felt. They felt the Pastor has no relevance anymore. They were now a…? [Congregation says, “arrogant,”] arrogant. Zvikanzi, “We can go it alone. We don’t need the man anymore.” If you go now, you can see their state now. Huh. Varume vatakatanga navo… Moziva takatanga navo kuvaka, vana Brother ava—va—va…vazukuru vangu vana Mukavhi ava, vatakatanga kuvaka navo?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Aivaka like a demon. [Congregation laughs—ED] (Inaudible 0:13:19) Ndiye akandivakira imba yangu kuMaenga ka uku, handitika ehe. [Congregation says, “mm-hmm.”] Manje Mukavhi ndiye atrain-a ani…? [Congregation says, “Satiya,”] Satiya. But manje Satiya ovaka kudarika ani manje…? [Congregation says, “Mukavhi.”] Handi’moona zvinoita hupenyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka unenge wa’akufunga kuti zvakazoita Mukavhi, akazokanganisika at the last minute. Iye zvino, takachema neimwe hama. Taitinana Brother Leo, tine vakomana veeku City Council kuGweru. Ndichi…ndadraw-esa plan ye extension yemba yangu yekuGweru, handi’moona. Ndobva paita umwe mupfanha anga ari engineer wandaida kuhaya. [to hire—ED] Zvikanzi, “But munhu aisimbogona kuvaka so ka, wokuti mukamuona iyeye Pastor, iyi imba anoiburitsa iyi. Mupfanha anonzi Mukavhi so. Anogona kuvaka imba iyi.” Saka umwe ndi architecture, mumwe ndiye anopasisa ma plan ku City Council. Zvikanzi neumwe wacho, zvikanzi “Ah, uya a’akuba kauya. [Congregation laughs—ED] Haapedze bhiridhini.” [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Tatakamira ipapo nehama idzi. Tikati, “Ah!” Zvikanzi, “Wuya aakuba. Ndiye akaisa building yanhingi iya. Anongoita building, ongochera chera odii… Osiya.” Zvikanzi, “Haa, imi muri mufundisi wuya anokuche—anokuchemedzai wuya.” Vapedza kutaura ndobva ndavaudza ndikati, “Aiwa, inini haangandidaro. Kungoti chete handichamutora.” Zvikanzi, “Hindava?” Ndikati, “Ndi…Akadzidzira kuvaka pano.” Zvikanzi, “Hoo momuziva?” Ndikati, “Ah stereki. Wakatanga nekuvaka kumusha kwangu kunonzi kuKenzamba.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Handi’mukuona. Unenge waraise-a munhu from no…? [Congregation says, “nothing.”] Aitokumbira kubva kuKenzamba kuuya kuzonyora ma tests ake kuGweru e building, e class one. Aidzidzira pamba pangu nesimendi yangu, handi’moona. But always what happens when people grow…? Ukateerera zvinotaura vanhu too…? [Congregation says, “too much.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: “You draw like a demon.” Handiti, he? Mupfanha anobva afunga kuti, “Haa…?...” Because unenge wa’akudraw-a manje ma—ma nude pictures emadzimai. Ma nude pictures evarume vanenge vakadaiwo. [Apostle Gumbura illustrates and Congregation laughs—ED] Aya anobhadharwa nokudiii iwayo…? [Congregation says, “nokukasira.”] Ehe, anokurumbidza kukupa twenty thousand rands one ti…? [Congregation says, “one time.”] Warasa faith yako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona kuti warasa faith yako? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ndosaka ukaropafadzwa ramba uchidzikira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: VaMarisa as long as he was under instruction he was a perfect guy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha? Aiti ukamudzidzisa kuti, “Paridza chakati.” Ainyatsopari—mazu… But paakatanga kuparidza vana Cave of Machpelah. Munoziva imimi vanhu munofurira vanhu chaizvo? Munhu akauya pano ane chizaruro chake muchiziva kuti Pastor vanoparidza kuti… “No, no, no. Haikona ku teacher zvako.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Unonyatsoona mumwe mupfanha anenge ada kukufurira kuti upanduke achiti, “Heee.” [Apostle Gumbura claps three times—ED] Anenge achiona kuti warasika handiti. entries.text: Unogozopuhwa revelation kuvanhu vanoparidzirwa neumwe munhu se…? [Congregation says, “sei?”] Hm? Kana Mwari achikupa revelation, anokutuma kwako we…? entries.text: Regera ministry yako ikure zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka,”] zvakanaka. Wanyatsozvimirira wokura, iswa maoko pai... entries.text: Taura Cave of Machpelah uri kuGokwe uko. Ha’moona. Then wotanga kuona basa rako richimira, richi blossomer handitika. Wokumbira kuti, “Pastor ndokumbira sovereignty.” Moona zvinoita mupfanha anetsika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. “Nda’andichikumbira kuti ndiite, go it alone.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ha’moona. Hakuna munhu anenge amisa boka, anokumbira kuita, go it alone anorambidzwa, on the basis of Scri…? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Anokupa three years. Hakuna arikukwa…. anokwanisa kuti a… Haagone kukurambidza. Akakuti usaite, handiti, ask for the reasons. If they are Scriptural obey, if there are not rebel. entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka muchiona, handiti. Mukanoona where do I get this method I’m telling you. Ndo method yakatora Paul. Pouro akaenda mudondo ku Arabia desert akapuhwa chizaruro. entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikuzviona zvaakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokunotaura navo kuti, “Inini maonero anguka ndiri kutumwa kuma Gentiles, imi makatumwa kuma Juta. Imi munongoenda kune vakadzingiswa, ini ndanzi ndiende kune vasina kudzingiswa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka ndiri kuona zvinhu izvi.” Murikuona zvakaita? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndobva azoti, “…I withstood Peter…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti a— ndakagara naye pasi. Ndikamuratidza revelation yandakapuhwa naMwari. Akagamuchira, kuti ma Gentiles haafaniri kudzi…? [Congregation says, “kudzingiswa.”] Kwazouuya vanhu vanobva kune vakadzingiswa akabva amira, kuenda parutivi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvikanzi, “Vanhu vanorwisa vanhu naPouro they do that to their own de…?” [Congregation says, “destruction.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikuona kunaka kwenyasha dzaMwarika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mupfanha akanga ari mu order yake chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Ndo order yaunofanira kukopa iyoyo. entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka October 2000 yedu yekuGweru. That was a landmark to me. And a very painful landmark, handi’moona. Yakandirwadza chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Woenda wonoparidza kuBhohera.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Wotondidaidzawo rimwe zuva kuti, “Mufundisi, ndaane two years ndichienda out. Basa randiri kubata ikoko hamusati mamboridii…? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosvika ikoko, ndosvika kwakavakwa imba yemusasa yakanaka naka, yeuswa yakafurikwa. Ehe, ndopinda imomo ndonzwa vanhu varikuimba, Machiona, Masungurwa nhasi

entries.text: [Congregation laughs—ED] Amen, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosvika ndotarisa, ndotarisa ndoona ndoona haaya, ndoona order irimo zvakanaka naka. entries.text: Aihwa Mwari haavharwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You don’t have to fight for God to manifest himse…? [Congregation says, “himself.”] Mukaona vanhu vanorwira kuda kuita shumiro ava. entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Isu tenge tichikuti brother kunoku. [Congregation laughs—ED] Kunoku unenge uri Brother Notice. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] [0:21:27 inaudible] [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ha’moona kuti Shumiro yadii…? Ehe shumiro yatanga. Handiti. Ndomatangirwo anoitwa shumiro chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiwo.”] You don’t go into a Church wotora vanhu twenty wonotanga Shumiro. It’s a curse that I cannot take off from a person. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Curse iyoyo yakaipa chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Don’t start your Ministry tha...? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka muchivanhu chaimo chaimo pasina maGwaro, Bhaibhiri rinoti iro, “Natsa kwaunodii…? [Congregation says, ‘kwaunobva,’] kwaunoenda chii…?” [Congregation says, “usiku.”] “Kudza baba namai kuti mazuva ako awande pai…? [Congregation says, “panyika.”] Huh?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Now wouya mu Church wotanga kutukana nevafundisi. “Havana kudanwa, havazi munhu waMwari, handivaterere. Hee, vakarasika chakati. entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu vanhu vaMwari. Haikona kuita shumiro yekuchemera. “He who ascended [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] is the one who…? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ukasangana na October 2000 ndopano perera kuparidza kwako ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Hm? But kana Mwari vakakudana, aaah! Hazvina basa kuti wasiirwa vanhu. Unogona kusara nema—ne—nema sister aya. Raini repamberi iri. Wosara nema brother aya raini repamberi apa. Vanhu ndevaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunouya va…? [Congregation says, “vamwe.”] Kunouya vamwe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Don’t you worry iwe ramba wakamira panzvimbo yako chete iwewe. Ramba uchizvi humbler zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe.”] Ehe.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka Message yenguva inoyi yazara renegadism. Chii chiri kukonzera izvozvo? Vatsvene vakawanda mu Message matsotsi! Chechi dzavanadzo vakadzitora nemadhiri ya. Chidhira chinenge chechi Nigerian. Hazvinei naMwari muka…? [Congregation says, “mukati.”] Mwari havamo mu programme iyi.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Vanhu vakaenda kunobvuta machechi vakatanga kutsonda, kuita character assassination munhu anga ari pabasa raMwari. Vachiita character assassination kuvahedheni. Maropafadzo aanavo vose akabva kumunhu iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Vane nzeve dzekunzwa inzwai varanda vaShe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisikumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Ndosaka mukaona manje, Mwari ini ndakazozviona kuti haikona kufa wakache— waka—wakarwadzirwa Mwari. Mwari ega aona kuti varume vaya vakanganisa veGweru tarirai ho—ngozi yavakuripa vari ve…? [Congregation says, “vari vega.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Haiperi ngozi ye type iya. Brother inoenda kuvana, igoenda kuvazukuru. Igoenda nekuvazukuru ngozi iyo iya. Haina kunaka. Nekuti ukatadzira Mwari, unonochema kunani? Kana watadzira Mwari, ugochema kunani? Zvi—kanganisira munhu. Nokuti Mwari vakakuregerera munhu anogona kungo igno-wewa. [to be ignored—ED] But ukakanganisira Mwari wodii? Hah? Saka ndiri kukutii vanhu vaMwari chizvarwa chino chatiri kurarama chinochi, bata mweya waMwari muKereke. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka Message yedu yatiri kuparidza inonzi The Reve…? [Congregation says, “…lation.”] Ha’moona. Ndo revelation iyoyiyi. Inonzi The Revelation. Revelation yekuziva kuti muChechi… mu framework ye Church, from Sunday handitika. Mune ma spirits mangani…? [Congregation says, “maviri,”] maviri. One iri right, one iri wro…? [Congregation says, “wrong.”] And unenge uri mu framework.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Manje mistake yakaitwa mu Message ndeyekufunga kuti mweya iyi kaiyi. Ndobva tatadza kuziva kuti kwete. Ku Ephesus kwaPauro, mweya wetsvina waitova mumakwai aPauro iwayo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Handi’murikuona mamiriro azvazvakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. [Congregation says, “no.”] Ma’amune mweya yakadii mu church muya …? [Congregation says, “yakasiyana.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Mukuona kuti manga mume two spirits? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But iri Message Church imwe….? [Congregation says, “imwe chete.”] Inoparidzirwa na Pastor mumwe…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisikumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka izvozvi ndichiparidza imo munomu, mune mweya mingani muno…? [Congregation says, “miviri.”] Murikuona revelation yandiri kutaura iyi? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona nezuro takaratidzana kuti mweya uyu wakauya panguva yekuti Church yedu yepa Ephesus yakanga iri yakanzi, “Aiming at.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yaita aim at, ndobva yaita rela…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] MuTiyatira. Handi’mukuzviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tasvika mu Tiyatira manje ch—ch—chadzera chiya chabva chadzima cho…? [Congregation says, “chose.”] Ndosaka isusu ipo pano patiri ipo pano. Pakasimuka mweya uya wa 2000 uya waida kuzoparadza Church. Moziva chinangwa changa chiri pamweya uya? Kuti Church iparare zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Ndosaka muchiona patiri panapa takaita sei pano? Ndokunonzi kukunda Satani. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takamukunda here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikaramba tichinamataka varanda vaShe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokukunda kwatakamudii ikoku…? [Congregation says, “kwatakamuita.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: But don’t you lax. Nokuti mweya uwoyo unogara wakavandira kuti udii… upinde. Unogara uchida kupinda mweya iwoyu. Unogara wakavanda handi’moona. entries.text: Chizaruro chakauya kuna Johani. Chichibva kuna… kuna Mwari, kuna Ishe Jeso Kristu. Zvinhu zvanga zvichazoitika. Ndoda kuti mubatisise ipapo handitika. entries.text: Handei mberi tese: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: “Akaropafadzwa anonzwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anoverenga…” Kungonzwa kwauri kuita Message iyoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kungonzwa kwauri kuidii…? entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: And munhu anenge awuya kuzorizarura, munhu anenge aine ka prophetic insight. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anokwanisa kujoinidza maGwa…? [Congregation says, “maGwaro.”] Haazi munhu chero chero. Ndosaka rakatomirira muporofita, Malachi 4…? [Congregation says, “5.”] William Marrion Bra…? entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndovakauya, ndokutanga kutora zvinhu zviya zviya ndokutanga kutiratidza manje. entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikupaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukaona pese pata’akuyenda apa, ha’moona. Taku descrai-bhirwa [describe—ED] Jeso Kristu. Muri kupaona? entries.text: Muri kumuona uyu? NdiMwari arikuudza John zvinhu zvese izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Ha’moona ehe. entries.text: Verse 10: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s Day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet, Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna… Muri kuona akutaurirwa. “Nyora utumire kumakereke ese ari mu Asia.
